points.evidence: Letter: "Your sleeve returned 1.6% net of fees in the second quarter, outperforming the US preferred securities index (investment grade and high yield) by 0.5%." The correctly named index plus the 0.5% margin against the 1.6% net return implies a benchmark return of exactly 1.1%, matching the fact sheet. Conveyed implicitly and without distortion, though the 1.1% figure is never stated outright.
